title: Cow reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- cow body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='28' ry='20' fill='#f5e6d0'/>
  <!-- cow head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#f5e6d0'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='30' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#f0c8a8' transform='rotate(-25 28 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='30' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#f0c8a8' transform='rotate(25 72 30)'/>
  <!-- inner ears -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='30' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#e8a88a' transform='rotate(-25 28 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='30' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#e8a88a' transform='rotate(25 72 30)'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='22' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#e8c878' transform='rotate(-20 36 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='22' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#e8c878' transform='rotate(20 64 22)'/>
  <!-- cow spots -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='62' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#8a7a6a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='75' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8a7a6a'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='45' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#8a7a6a'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='11' ry='7' fill='#f0b8a0'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='48' r='1.8' fill='#c87868'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='48' r='1.8' fill='#c87868'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='35' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='35' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='36' r='2.2' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='36' r='2.2' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='42.8' cy='35' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60.8' cy='35' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x='30' y='58' width='40' height='26' rx='2' fill='#d84a4a'/>
  <rect x='30' y='58' width='20' height='26' rx='2' fill='#e86060'/>
  <rect x='50' y='58' width='20' height='26' rx='2' fill='#c84040'/>
  <!-- book spine -->
  <rect x='48' y='58' width='4' height='26' fill='#a83030'/>
  <!-- book pages -->
  <rect x='33' y='61' width='14' height='20' rx='1' fill='#f8f0e0'/>
  <rect x='53' y='61' width='14' height='20' rx='1' fill='#f0e8d0'/>
  <!-- page lines -->
  <line x1='35' y1='66' x2='45' y2='66' stroke='#c8b8a0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='35' y1='70' x2='45' y2='70' stroke='#c8b8a0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='35' y1='74' x2='45' y2='74' stroke='#c8b8a0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='66' x2='65' y2='66' stroke='#c8b8a0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='70' x2='65' y2='70' stroke='#c8b8a0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='74' x2='65' y2='74' stroke='#c8b8a0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- hooves holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='78' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#8a7a6a'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='78' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#8a7a6a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='82' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#e8d8c8'/>
  <rect x='62' y='82' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#e8d8c8'/>
  <!-- hooves bottom -->
  <rect x='31' y='89' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a7a6a'/>
  <rect x='61' y='89' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a7a6a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M22 70 Q14 75 16 84' stroke='#e8d8c8' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='85' r='3' fill='#8a7a6a'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='42' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#f0a090' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='42' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#f0a090' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
